page_title: RBL 1-0 BOC | RB Leipzig v Bochum 24/08/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The match has just finished.
90+5' Benjamin Brand blows his whistle. Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) commits a foul after dangerous play.
90+3' Bochum can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
90+2' Aliou Balde (Bochum) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. The referee blows his whistle, Bochum are awarded a corner kick.
90+1' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
88' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
88' The defender bravely blocks the shot from David Raum (RB Leipzig) inside the box. The ball goes out for a corner. RB Leipzig can continue in their attacking effort.
87' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Bochum comes to nothing.

87' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Samuel Bamba (Bochum) finds some space inside the box and gets in a strike, but the shot is brilliantly blocked by one of the defending players sliding in. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Bochum.
86' The game has come to an end for Moritz Broschinski. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Samuel Bamba (Bochum).
86' Peter Zeidler has decided to substitute Jakov Medic and he is replaced by Tim Oermann (Bochum).
86' That's the end of the game for Lois Openda, who is replaced by Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig).
85' Willi Orban (RB Leipzig) makes an awful challenge on his opponent and the referee shows him a deserved red card!
81' Ibrahima Sissoko (Bochum) is shown a yellow card after a horrible tackle.
79' Mats Pannewig (Bochum) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Benjamin Brand blows for a foul.
77' The resulting corner from Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) is cleared.
77' Mats Pannewig (Bochum) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Bochum have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
75' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Amadou Haidara leaves the pitch and Lukas Klostermann (RB Leipzig) comes on.
75' Marco Rose has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Yussuf Poulsen (RB Leipzig) replacing Benjamin Sesko.
74' Amadou Haidara (RB Leipzig) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Benjamin Brand blows his whistle for a foul.
73' Bochum enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
71' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Anthony Losilla departs the field of play to be replaced by Mats Pannewig (Bochum).
71' Here is a change. Philipp Hofmann is going off and Peter Zeidler gives the last tactical orders to Aliou Balde (Bochum).
70' The ref blows his whistle and we are going to have a so-called cooling break due to the high temperature.
67' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 8:5.
63' Today's match ends for Lukas Daschner who will be replaced by Myron Boadu (Bochum).

61' Great solo effort by Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) as he tricks his way through the defence before firing a low drive from just outside of the box towards the middle of the goal. Patrick Drewes is alert and denies him.
59' 1 - 0 Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) has a sight of goal and unleashes a strike from the edge of the penalty area that somehow goes past the helpless goalkeeper.
57' A clumsy foul by Matus Bero (Bochum) and Benjamin Brand blows his whistle.
56' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig).

56' Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to RB Leipzig.
55' Marco Rose prepares a substitution. Nicolas Seiwald is replaced by Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig).
55' Substitution. Benjamin Henrichs (RB Leipzig) has come on for Mohamed Simakan.
54' Flag up against Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
52' Ibrahima Sissoko (Bochum) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Benjamin Brand has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
50' Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig) rises high to meet a cross from the corner kick and plants a header from inside the penalty area. His effort went just narrowly wide of the left post.
50' The referee awards a corner and Castello Lukeba (RB Leipzig) goes over to take it.
49' RB Leipzig have a corner. Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
46' Philipp Hofmann (Bochum) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low drive towards the middle of the net, but Peter Gulacsi is alert and denies him.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+3' David Raum (RB Leipzig) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.

45+3' A lofted cross from Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. The ball goes out of play and RB Leipzig have been awarded a corner kick.
45+2' The corner kick from Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
45+1' The free kick from close range, taken by RB Leipzig, is intercepted by one of the defenders. RB Leipzig have been awarded a corner kick.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
44' The corner from Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) is intercepted by the defence.
44' Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Corner kick. RB Leipzig will have an opportunity.

43' Willi Orban (RB Leipzig) reacts well and displays good awareness inside the box to get on the end of the resulting corner kick. He fails to direct the ball into the net as it flies narrowly over the crossbar.
43' Good work from RB Leipzig as they win a corner.
42' Mohamed Simakan (RB Leipzig) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger. RB Leipzig get a corner.

40' What a great effort! Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) decides to unleash a long-range shot. Despite hitting it very well, it scorches inches wide of the left post. We could have witnessed a magnificent goal.
39' The corner is swung in but RB Leipzig can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
38' A cross from Amadou Haidara (RB Leipzig) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
37' Amadou Haidara (RB Leipzig) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
35' Benjamin Brand shows a yellow card to Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) for his blatant foul.
33' Amadou Haidara (RB Leipzig) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
31' Moritz Broschinski (Bochum) wastes a golden opportunity inside the box by shooting straight into the back of an opponent when the goal was at his mercy.
31' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) is penalised for a foul. Benjamin Brand had a clear view and blows his whistle.
30' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) takes a short corner kick.
30' The ball is out of play. RB Leipzig win a corner kick. Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig) has a crack at goal from inside the box, but the defender somehow makes the block to deny him.

25' A pass travels right across the box to Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) and gives him a sight of goal. He tries to beat the keeper in the bottom right corner, but Patrick Drewes denies him with a decent save.
24' Matus Bero (Bochum) produces a long-range volley, but the ball was blocked by a defender on its way.
23' Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Benjamin Brand had an easy-decision to make.
20' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 66:34.
17' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) gets on the end of a lofted pass near the penalty spot, but it's a poor header and drifts high over the bar.
15' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Matus Bero (Bochum) was quite harsh and Benjamin Brand didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
14' Castello Lukeba (RB Leipzig) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Benjamin Brand saw the whole situation.
12' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
11' Moritz Broschinski (Bochum) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
7' Philipp Hofmann (Bochum) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
5' Great teamplay by RB Leipzig as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
2' PENALTY APPEAL after Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Bochum will have the kick-off.
Benjamin Brand is the one to supervise the game today.
